We need to apply template 1914391 to the molecule from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-4? Actually that answer gave precursors list: ["CCOC(C[C@@H]1O[C@H](/C=C(/C)C(OC)=O)[C@H](C)[C@@H](O)CH2)=O", "O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F"] That's from previous step. But now we need to return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of task make_5_lvl1-template_search-5 to the molecule below. The molecule below? Not given explicitly but likely the same as earlier? The template search 5 gave mapped_rxn and template_id. The mapped_rxn shows product side (right) is the target molecule? The mapped_rxn: left side reagents: [CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:11]([CH3:12])[C@@H:13]([CH:14]=[O:18])[O:21]1 .C[CH:16](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)[C:15]#[C:17][O:19][CH3:20]>> product: ... So the product is the target molecule. So we need to apply template to that product to get precursors. The product SMILES is the right side: [CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:11]([CH3:12])[C@@H:13](/[CH:14]=[C:15](/[CH3:16])[C:17](=[O:18])[O:19][CH3:20])[O:21]1

We need to convert to normal SMILES (without atom mapping). Let's strip mapping numbers and brackets. The product SMILES likely: CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC(O)C(C)C@@H(/C=C(C)C(=O)OCH3)O1? Wait earlier we attempted that. The mapping shows a side chain: /CH:14 = [C:15] ( /CH3:16 ) [C:17](=O:18)[O:19][CH3:20] i.e., a methyl ester attached to a double bond. So product is a cyclic sugar derivative with a side chain. The earlier attempts gave similar SMILES but errors due to stereochemistry maybe. The apply_template tool failing due to stereochemistry parsing. Could try to remove stereochemistry markers? Use generic SMILES without @? Let's construct a simpler SMILES: CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC(O)C(C)C@@H(/C=C(C)C(=O)OCH3)O1 . Might still cause error. Maybe the tool expects no stereochemistry? Let's try without @ symbols.
